name: The Vow: Vampire's Curse
storyline:
Some may call it a tale of love, or of revenge and death, but at its heart, it is a story of survival…

You play as Richard, a righteous knight who is about to marry his beloved, the beautiful Eleanor. But right at their wedding ceremony, the evil (but handsome) vampire Arnaud storms into the chapel, filling the room with his dark power, steals Eleanor, and kills Richard.

The next morning, Richard wakes up in the church with his teacher, Bertrand, kneeling beside him in shock. Richard has been resurrected.
After recovering from the shock, Bertrand explains what happened the night before. Richard swears to save Eleanor from the evil grasp of Arnaud and begins his crusade toward Arnaud’s dark castle at the top of the mountain.
On his journey, Richard passes through villages raided by Arnaud’s servants. He helps villagers fortify their homes against the night raids, defends them from the creatures, and protects their lands. But if the village falls, Richard falls with it, and awakens once more in the church beside Bertrand. It is then that he understands that this is not a miracle, this is a curse. Every time he dies, he must start his crusade all over again. Along the way, Richard encounters familiar faces, friends, allies, some are shocked to see him alive, and others may challenge him, forcing difficult choices that shape his journey.

In the end, it is you who will decide the fate of Richard, the villages, and whether he can save his beloved Eleanor.
summary: A dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder fused with turn-based tactics. Build your deck, master deadly synergies, and survive seven cursed nights to rescue your fiancée from the vampire’s grasp.
